title: 第二章 领地已经升级了？
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
秦天刚刚同意开火请求。

    嗖！嗖！嗖！

    穿云狙击塔顿时齐刷刷的射出无数支弓箭，呼啸着朝着目标四面八方射去，在空中划过一道道优美的弧线。

    下一刻。

    轰！

    远处再次响起一道闷响。

    【叮！穿云狙击塔已击杀棕熊*1，获得经验值10】

    【叮！穿云狙击塔已击杀灰狼*1，获得经验值5】

    ……

    无数提示音顿时在秦天脑海之中响起，他眼神之中满是喜色。

    肉眼看见，经验值那一栏也一直在提升。

    这轰鸣声足足持续了好一会儿才停止了下来。

    这一刻。

    方圆三公里内，不管是地上跑的，还是天上飞的所有生物，都被全部清空了！

    震撼！

    无与伦比的震撼！

    站在下方的十个领民顿时傻眼了，一个个长大了嘴巴。

    半晌，他们才从震撼之中反应过来，其中一人连忙对着秦天五体投地，口中大喊。

    “领主大人威武！”

    其他人也纷纷反应了过来，有模有样的朝着秦天恭敬道：“领主大人威武！”

    他们的脸上带着激动亢奋，是对秦天的绝对狂热崇拜。

    秦天笑着道：“你们现在先去把刚才猎物的肉抗回来，然后去外面尽快搜集资源，记住一定要在三公里的射程范围内。”

    众人齐声大喊道：“是，领主大人请放心！我们一定努力收集材料！”

    说完之后，众人纷纷跑出领地去搜集资源。

    秦天也随即将目光放回了信息面板。

    防御塔或者领民击杀的怪物，他只能享受百分之五十的经验，可他的等级还是提升了。

    【领主：秦天】

    【当前等级：8（10级内每一次升级所需10经验值）】

    秦天握了握拳，前所未有的力量充斥着他的全身，他能够感觉到自己现在的力量和速度都提升了好几个级别。

    接下来自己就只需要等着领民将刚才猎杀的猎物全部抗回来就可以了，不过不知道其他人现在怎么样了。
content_en:
Qin Tian just agreed to the request to fire.

    Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!

    The Cloud Chuan sniper tower suddenly fired out countless bows and arrows, whizzing towards the target in all directions, drawing beautiful arcs in the air.

    The next moment.

    boom!

    There was another muffled sound in the distance.

    【bite! The Cloud Piercer Sniper Tower has killed 1 brown bear and gained 10 experience points]

    [Ding! Cloud Piercer Sniper Tower has killed Gray Wolf*1 and gained 5 experience points]

    …

    Countless notification tones suddenly sounded in Qin Tian's mind, and his eyes were full of joy.

    It can be seen with the naked eye that the experience value column has been increasing.

    The roar lasted for quite a while before it stopped.

    This moment.

    Within a radius of three kilometers, all creatures running on the ground and flying in the sky have been cleared away!

    Shocking!

    Unparalleled shock!

    The ten leaders standing below were dumbfounded, and each one had their mouths opened.

    It took them a while to recover from the shock, and one of them quickly threw himself at Qin Tian and shouted.

    "Lord, you are mighty!"

    Others also reacted one after another, and respectfully said to Qin Tian: "Lord, you are mighty!"

    There was excitement and excitement on their faces, showing their absolute fanatical admiration for Qin Tian.

    Qin Tian smiled and said: "Now you go to fight back the meat of the prey just now, and then go outside to collect resources as soon as possible. Remember, it must be within a three-kilometer range."

    Everyone shouted in unison: "Yes, please don't worry, Lord! We will work hard to collect materials!"

    After saying that, everyone ran out of the territory to collect resources.

    Qin Tian also immediately returned his gaze to the information panel.

    He could only enjoy 50% of the experience from monsters killed by defensive towers or territorial citizens, but his level still improved.

    [Lord: Qin Tian]

    [Current level: 8 (10 experience points required for each upgrade within 10 levels)]

    Qin Tian clenched his fists, and unprecedented strength filled his body. He could feel that his current strength and speed had increased by several levels.

    Next, I just need to wait for the people to fight back all the prey they just killed, but I don't know how the others are doing now.
title_en: Chapter 2 The territory has been upgraded?
